title: A Quick Team Standup
summaryZh: 團隊早會上，成員回報昨天進度和今天計畫，並提出遇到的問題。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Morning everyone, let's keep this short. What did you finish yesterday?
sentences.zh: 大家早，我們長話短說。你昨天完成了什麼？
sentences.note: did you → /dɪdʒə/，兩字合併成 /dʒ/ 音。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I finished the login page and sent it to the design team.
sentences.zh: 我把登入頁面做完了，也傳給設計團隊了。
sentences.note: sent it to → /sɛnɪɾə/，sent it 連讀且 t 弱化，to 弱讀成 /tə/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Nice work. Did they give you any feedback on it yet?
sentences.zh: 做得好。他們已經給你任何回饋了嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Not yet, but they promised to send notes by this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 還沒，不過他們答應今天下午前會給意見。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Good. And what are you planning to work on today?
sentences.zh: 很好。那你今天打算做什麼？
sentences.note: what are you → /wʌɾɚjə/，t 變閃音，are 和 you 都弱讀。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I'll start on the payment form and write a few tests.
sentences.zh: 我會開始做付款表單，再寫幾個測試。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sounds good to me. Is anything blocking you at the moment?
sentences.zh: 我覺得沒問題。你現在有被什麼卡住嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: One thing. The test server went down again last night.
sentences.zh: 有一件事。測試伺服器昨晚又掛掉了。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I couldn't run anything after six, so I lost some time.
sentences.zh: 六點之後我什麼都跑不了，所以浪費了一些時間。
sentences.note: couldn't 的 t 幾乎不發音，變成鼻腔停頓 /ˈkʊdn̩t/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sorry about that. I'll ask Ray to look at it today.
sentences.zh: 真抱歉。我今天會請 Ray 去看一下。
sentences.note: look at it → /lʊkəɾɪt/，三字連讀，at 的 t 變閃音。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Thanks. If it stays down, I'll work on the tests instead.
sentences.zh: 謝謝。如果還是掛著，我就先去寫測試。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That works. Remember we're showing this build to the client on Friday.
sentences.zh: 可以。記得我們星期五要把這個版本展示給客戶。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I know. I should be done with everything by Thursday night.
sentences.zh: 我知道。我星期四晚上前應該就能全部完成。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Great, that gives us a full day to fix problems.
sentences.zh: 太好了，這樣我們還有一整天可以修問題。
sentences.note: gives us → /ɡɪvzəs/，s 接母音連讀，us 弱讀成 /əs/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Okay, that's it from me. Let's get back to work.
sentences.zh: 好，我這邊就這樣。大家回去工作吧。

questions.q: What did the team member finish yesterday?

options: The design team sent late feedback
He could not find his notes
The test server went down at night
They show the build to the client
